newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Papers to refurbish facilities.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Papers to refurbish facilities.

text.p: Consolidated Papers Inc said it will launch a $180-million capital improvement program in 1997.

Included in the program are expansion of a warehouse at the Converting Division in Wisconsin Rapids, addition of a second hot-soft calender at the Stevens Point Divison in Stevens Point, Wis., replacement of equipment at the Biron Division in Biron, Wis., and other projects.
Consolidated said it expects capital spending to reach $275 million this year and $200 million in 1997.
Consolidated in the largest North American producer of coated printing papers and other paper products.
